summary.text: Sean Garballey is a Democratic state representative from the 23rd Middlesex District who has served since 2009 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He chairs the Joint Committee on Tourism, Arts and Cultural Development.

paragraphs.text: Sean Garballey earned a B.A. in political science from the University of Massachusetts Lowell and has attended Suffolk University, according to Ballotpedia.
Garballey assumed office in the Massachusetts House in 2009.
For 2025-2026 he chaired the Tourism, Arts and Cultural Development Joint Committee, and in 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 he chaired the House Global Warming and Climate Change Committee.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
